newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent Group unleaded differentials firm.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent Group unleaded differentials firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials in Group Three firmed on increased demand for late-month barrels, traders said on Monday.
As discussion in September deliveries began to wind down, short-covering created increased demand for prompt September barrels in the Group, traders said.
Despite talk of a two million barrel shipment of gasoline due to arrive in the market late in the week, the short-covering pushed differentials higher, traders said.

Group Three prompt unleaded gasoline differentials remained 0.25 cent a gallon under to even with the print, retaining strength from earlier in the day. Later deliveries were unchanged at 0.75/0.50 cent under the print and premium remained 2.50 cents higher.

Chicago late-September unleaded gasoline was steady at 1.50/1.25 cents under the print with premium talked 2.75 cents higher. Trade in September unleaded was expected to close on Wednesday, traders said.

Low sulphur diesel fuel differentials were steady at 1.50/1.25 cents over the print in the Group and 0.75/1.0 cent over in Chicago. High sulphur was discussed 0.50 cent a gallon under the print in both markets.
Jet/kero was steady at bids 2.75 cents a gallon over the print in the Group and 3.0 cents over in Chicago.
